Name: Agromancy
Author: Spiderbuttons
Description:
[size=3][b]Agromancy[/b] is a magic-flavoured crop genetics mod that allows you to improve your crops over the course of your playthrough by managing their magical essences. Every crop has a default set of magical essences that they come into existence with, but by infusing their seeds with even more essence (which you can gain by extracting from other crops), you can gain the benefits of quicker growth times, higher quality, larger yields, and more! Since each crop has its own base essences, some crops will start with more or less of some kinds of magical essences, so you'd benefit from growing a variety of crops to collect each of the different types of magical essences in order to create magically perfect crops.

[b]How do I extract essences?
[/b][/size]You use the Agrometer!

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Spiderbuttons/Agromancy/refs/heads/main/Promo/Agrometer.png[/img]

Using the Agrometer will open up the UI shown above, showing you all of the crops in your inventory that have some amount of magical essences in them. The more essences a particular crop has, the more those six liquid containers will fill up, and the brighter your crop will glow. Each of those six containers represents one of the six different types of magical essence, and you can hover over them to see what each essence does.

When you've decided which crop you want to extract from (you can cycle through them with those pink arrows), you can click on any of the six essences to extract that specific essence, or you can click the ALL button at the top to extract every essence at once. However, to do so, you need to make sure you have an [b]Essence Vial[/b] attached to the Agrometer, as that is where the essence is stored. When you get your Agrometer, it will come with an essence vial already attached (in the same way one attaches bait to a fishing rod).

Keep in mind that by default, the more you drain a crop of its essences, the less valuable it will be. If you completely drain a crop of essence, it will disappear completely! Both of these things are configurable, though.

[b]How do I get an Agrometer?
[/b]It will come to you eventually, so long as you intend to farm.

Until you find your Agrometer, there will be a random chance for it to pop out of the ground whenever you hoe some dirt. The odds of finding one go up the further into the save you are, but it's pretty easy to find one on day 1 if you just till a lot of dirt. Don't worry, I didn't make starting out difficult.

[b]What exactly is an Essence Vial?[/b]
Your Agrometer will come with a [b]Tier 1 Essence Vial[/b] attached. An Essence Vial is where all of your extracted essences are stored, with no limit on how much of each essence can be stored inside the Essence Vial. However, there is a limit to how much each tier of Essence Vial is able to [i]infuse[/i] into crops. The Tier 1 Essence Vial that you will start out with is only capable of infusing a small amount of essence into a crop, only reaching a maximum essence infusion that is 1/3rd of what can be considered magically perfect. A Tier 2 Essence Vial can infuse up to 2/3rds, and a Tier 3 Essence Vial is capable of completely suffusing crops with magical essence.

Keep in mind, though, that [i]crops[/i] cannot be infused. Seeds, however, can be! In order to switch to infusion mode, you need to pour stuff out of your Essence Vial instead of dumping stuff into it. So turn your Agrometer upside down! Click the arrow beneath the Essence Vial in the menu to rotate the Agrometer menu and swap to infusion mode. In this mode, valid seeds will be shown instead of crops. You can then click on individual essences or the ALL button like before to drain your Essence Vial in order to infuse the selected seed.

[b]Why should I infuse seeds?[/b]
When you harvest a crop grown from an infused seed, it will inherit the essence of the seed that was planted, which is how you can improve your crops over time. Now, obviously if you harvest only a single crop, you have to make the choice between extracting its essence, and thus lowering its value, in order to create equivalent seeds, or just selling it outright.[i] However[/i], some crops already have a chance of giving you more crops than the number of seeds spent to grow it... why not take a look at the essences of those crops?

If you're really not fussed about infusing seeds, though, by default a crop will have its essences randomly "mutated" when you harvest them. That is, there will be some very small variation between the essences of the planted seed and the final crop. This means that you can, over a long period of time, gain more essences. It will take a long time, though, and the variations can just as easily be negative mutations, too. Naturally, this stuff is also configurable.

[b]How do I get a higher tier of Essence Vial?
[/b]After obtaining your Agrometer, you will learn the recipes for [b]Agromantic Pedestals[/b] and [b]Agromantic Altars[/b]. If you set up one altar and four pedestals correctly, you can begin a ritual for upgrading your Essence Vials.

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Spiderbuttons/Agromancy/refs/heads/main/Promo/Altars.png[/img]﻿
(They don't need to go in the Secret Woods, I just thought it made for a prettier screenshot.)

If you place your Essence Vial upon the altar and surround it with pedestals as shown, the ritual will enter the preparation phase. Each of the pedestals will show a series of crops along with a quality. For example, in that screenshot above, the bottom left pedestal is showing a silver-quality hot pepper. In actuality, that pepper will change every second to show one [i]possible[/i] option you can place upon the pedestal, depending on the tier of Essence Vial you placed upon the altar.

In order to upgrade a Tier 1 Essence Vial to Tier 2, you must place silver-quality or better [i]Summer crops[/i] on the pedestals. To upgrade from Tier 2 to Tier 3, you must place gold-quality or better [i]Fall[/i] crops upon the pedestals. Valid items will then show a stream of essence flowing into the vial, like the corn, summer spangle, and butternut squash shown in that picture. Once each pedestal has a valid item, the ritual will begin, and you will end up with an Essence Vial that is one tier higher than it was before. Don't worry, the vial will retain its essence, though it may [i]appear[/i] emptier due to having a higher infusion capacity.

Upgraded Essence Vials can be attached to your Agrometer just the same as the Tier 1 Essence Vial.

[b]I lost my Essence Vial / Agrometer ):
[/b]First of all, you should be more careful! Second of all, if you happen to lose either of your Agromantic tools, they can be re-purchased from the Lost Items shop (the one with the Crow) in the Secret Woods the day after you lose it. It will cost the same as any other item in that shop, though (10,000 gold).

[b]Does this work with modded crops?
[/b]Yes! Every crop, modded or otherwise, will have a base set of essences calculated for it. Any crop, modded or otherwise, will also benefit from any essences that are applied to its seeds. They will also be accepted on the Agromantic Pedestals (like the Cornucopia crops in that screenshot up above).

[b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Extract the mod into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5][b]Compatibility
[/b][/size]There are no currently known incompatibilities. If you run into a compatibility error with another mod, please leave a bug report and I will do my best to make it work!

[b][size=5]Future Plans[/size][/b][list]
[*]More rituals!
[*]Perhaps some Agromantic spells using the Essence Vial as fuel?
[*]Let me know if you have any other cool or fun suggestions!
[/list]
[b][size=5]Configuration
[/size][/b]This mod does some with some configuration options. You can access the configuration via Generic Mod Config Menu, where each config option will describe what it does when you hover over it. If you feel that this mod would benefit from some extra configurability in some areas, please do feel free to let me know.
